name: Jack Henry & Associates, Inc.
summary:
Jack Henry & Associates (JKHY) reported earnings of $1.57 per share on revenue of $644.02 million for the fiscal fourth quarter ended June 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $1.44 per share on revenue of $629.46 million. The company beat consensus estimates by 9.03% while revenue grew 4.66% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it expects fiscal 2027 earnings of $7.33 to $7.38 per share on revenue of $2.659 billion to $2.684 billion. The current consensus earnings estimate is $7.11 per share on revenue of $2.68 billion for the year ending June 30, 2027.

Jack Henry & Associates, Inc is a provider of information processing solutions for community banks. Its products and services includes processing transactions, automating business processes and managing information.
subject: Jack Henry & Associates Beat Consensus Estimates
